AttendSmartly keeps your college attendance under control, so you always know where you stand before you skip a class.

Mark each class Present, Absent or Cancelled in one tap, and every subject shows its percentage against its own target, with a plain verdict like "You can safely miss 2 classes" or "Attend the next 7 to reach 75%".

FEATURES
• Today at a glance: overall attendance, classes to attend or safely miss, and today's timetable
• Safe-bunk calculator for every subject, including labs that count as two or more units
• Subject pages with a colour-coded month calendar, trend chart and recent classes
• Weekly timetable with rooms, teachers and date ranges, plus extra, cancelled and rescheduled classes
• Scan a photo of your timetable to add classes, read entirely on your iPhone
• Analytics: subject ranking, best and weakest subject, goal bars and weekly trend
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Holidays, semester tracking and class reminders
• Weekly automatic backups, plus import and export compatible with the Android app
• Pastel design in light mode, jewel tones in dark mode

PRIVACY
No accounts, no servers, no analytics. Your data and profile photo never leave your iPhone.

AttendSmartly for iOS is open source (GPL-3.0) and based on the AttendSmartly Android app by Animesh Gupta.
